name: Camping 101: Skinning
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, new skinners learn how to make a chair for camp from harvested hides. The lesson points them toward craftsmen who teach the trade across Azeroth.

sections.title: Comfort in the Wilds
sections.body: A sharp blade is not enough to last in the wilds; you also need to know how to save your strength between trials. Adventurers can build basic skill in the field and use treated skins to make camp chairs. Those comforts give weary travelers a place to rest and recover before facing danger again.

sections.title: Mastering the Craft
sections.body: Young Forsaken skinners in Tirisfal Glades who reach their first measure of skill are sent to Rand Rhobart. He works along the road between Brill and the Capital ruins of the Undercity. Rhobart teaches practical ways to turn rough leather into a seat for camp. Skinning masters across the lands of the Horde and Alliance teach the same craft.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The lesson sends new skinners to a skilled trade mentor, who teaches them to make a camp chair from harvested animal pelts.

faq.q: Who offers this training in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton gives the lesson in Tirisfal Glades and points new skinners toward Rand Rhobart, along the road between Brill and the Undercity.

faq.q: What skill level is required to complete this task?
aliases: what skinning level do i need
faq.answer: You need a skinning skill of at least twenty before a trainer will teach you to make equipment for camp.

faq.q: Where can Rand Rhobart be found?
faq.answer: Rand Rhobart works along the main road south from Brill toward the entrance to the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Can members of other factions learn this technique?
faq.answer: Yes. Forsaken learn from Rand Rhobart, while other instructors teach skinners in Goldshire, Ironforge, Dolanaar, Orgrimmar, Bloodhoof Village, and Shen'dar Village.

faq.q: Why is crafting a camp chair useful?
aliases: what does a camp chair do
faq.answer: A camp chair gives you a comfortable place to sit and regain your strength in the wilds, helping you stay rested and alert for battles ahead.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may be free from mortal exhaustion, but a working camp remains useful while you hunt the plagued beasts of Tirisfal.
As a member of the Horde, you can make use of every part of a slain beast, leaving nothing to waste along the hard road.
